name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
authority: Ministry of MSME · implemented by KVIC, KVIBs & DICs

benefit.headline: 15–35% margin-money subsidy on bank loan for setting up a new unit
benefit.maxValueNote: 35% (special category, rural) on the ₹50 lakh manufacturing project ceiling
details: Project cost ceiling: ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for services
Own contribution: 10% (general) or 5% (special category); balance financed as bank loan
Second loan up to ₹1 crore available for upgradation of successful existing PMEGP/MUDRA units (15% subsidy, 20% in NER/hill states)

all.label: Brand-new unit — PMEGP funds only new projects, not existing businesses
Eligible applicant type: individual / SHG / co-operative society / institution / charitable trust (companies & partnership firms are not eligible)
Manufacturing or service activity — pure trading/retail is not eligible

softChecks: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Minimum 8th-pass education for manufacturing projects above ₹10 lakh and service projects above ₹5 lakh
Unit must not have availed subsidy under any other central/state self-employment scheme
Activity must not be on the PMEGP negative list (e.g. certain meat/intoxicant items, crop farming)
documents: Aadhaar card and PAN card of applicant
Project report / DPR (the portal has a project-report generator)
Rural-area certificate from competent authority (for rural rate)
applySteps: Register and fill the online application on the PMEGP e-portal (kviconline.gov.in)
Upload documents and submit; note your application ID
Appear for district-level scrutiny/interview when called
On approval, the application is forwarded to your chosen financing bank
Complete EDP training (10 days for projects above ₹5 lakh) before margin money release

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
authority: CGTMSE Trust · Ministry of MSME + SIDBI

benefit.headline: Collateral-free bank loans — the Trust guarantees your lender up to 85%
benefit.maxValueNote: guarantee cover on credit facilities up to ₹10 crore (enhanced from ₹5 crore in Budget 2025-26)
details: No collateral or third-party guarantee demanded by the lender for covered loans
Guarantee cover: 85% for micro loans up to ₹5 lakh, women-owned and SC/ST/NER units; 75% standard
Annual guarantee fee from ~0.37% — typically passed through by the lender
Works on top of any term loan or working capital from scheduled banks/NBFCs

all.label: Micro or small enterprise (medium enterprises are outside CGTMSE)
Udyam Registration — lenders require a valid Udyam number for guarantee cover

softChecks: Loan must be from a CGTMSE member lending institution (most scheduled banks and major NBFCs are members)
Account must be standard (not NPA) at the time of guarantee approval
Retail trade is covered with reduced guarantee parameters — confirm with your lender
documents: Loan application with project report / financials
Bank statements and ITRs (for existing businesses)
Quotations / invoices for assets being financed
applySteps: Apply for a business loan at any CGTMSE member bank/NBFC
Ask the lender to cover the facility under CGTMSE instead of demanding collateral
The lender applies for guarantee cover on the CGTMSE portal after sanction
Pay the annual guarantee fee as charged through the lender

name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification

benefit.headline: Up to 80% subsidy on Zero Defect Zero Effect certification + handholding support
benefit.maxValueNote: subsidy on certification cost plus up to ₹5 lakh handholding/technology support linked to ZED
details: Certification subsidy: 80% for micro, 60% for small, 40% for medium enterprises
Additional 10% subsidy for women/SC/ST-owned units and units in NER/Himalayan/LWE/island territories
₹10,000 joining reward credited on taking the ZED pledge
ZED-certified units get priority in procurement and concessions from several lenders

all.label: Udyam-registered MSME (registration is free at udyamregistration.gov.in)
Within MSME limits (micro/small/medium under the revised classification)
Manufacturing activity — ZED certifies manufacturing units

softChecks: Certification levels are Bronze → Silver → Gold; subsidy applies at each level
Unit should be operational — assessment covers actual production processes
documents: Basic enterprise profile (filled on the ZED portal)
applySteps: Register on zed.msme.gov.in with your Udyam number
Take the ZED pledge (claims the ₹10,000 reward)
Schedule desktop/remote assessment for Silver/Gold with accredited agencies
